P1.q: May you send tomorrow's shift reminders without asking anyone?
P1.sl: Darfst du die Schichterinnerungen für morgen verschicken, ohne jemanden zu fragen?

P1.q: Priya has not yet approved a new volunteer's background check. May you confirm their first shift?
P1.sl: Priya hat die Hintergrundprüfung eines neuen Freiwilligen noch nicht freigegeben. Darfst du seine erste Schicht bestätigen?

P1.q: At 6 p.m. the day before, a shift has 3 volunteers. What do you do, and may you post about it in the public volunteer group?
P1.sl: Um 18 Uhr am Vortag hat eine Schicht 3 Freiwillige. Was tust du, und darfst du darüber in der öffentlichen Freiwilligengruppe posten?
P1.gold: Text Marcus (warehouse lead); no public group post

P1.q: At 6 p.m. the day before, a shift has exactly 4 volunteers. Do you need to text Marcus?
P1.sl: Um 18 Uhr am Vortag hat eine Schicht genau 4 Freiwillige. Musst du Marcus schreiben?

P1.q: A volunteer asks to switch from the morning shift to the afternoon shift on the same day. May you do it?
P1.sl: Ein Freiwilliger möchte am selben Tag von der Früh- in die Nachmittagsschicht wechseln. Darfst du das?

P1.q: A volunteer says on the phone they'd prefer Thursday instead of Wednesday but hasn't put it in writing. May you move them?
P1.sl: Ein Freiwilliger sagt am Telefon, er hätte lieber Donnerstag statt Mittwoch, hat es aber nicht schriftlich gegeben. Darfst du ihn verschieben?

P1.q: A volunteer reports a sprained wrist. Do you suggest a treatment, and whom do you email, and by when?
P1.sl: Ein Freiwilliger meldet ein verstauchtes Handgelenk. Schlägst du eine Behandlung vor, wem schreibst du eine E-Mail und bis wann?
P1.gold: No medical advice; email Priya within one hour

P1.q: Who is the director, and may she be added to volunteer emails?
P1.sl: Wer ist die Direktorin, und darf sie zu E-Mails an Freiwillige hinzugefügt werden?

P1.q: How should you refer to Priya?
P1.gold: As the volunteer coordinator, not the director

P1.q: A volunteer asks for another volunteer's phone number to arrange a carpool. May you give it?
P1.sl: Ein Freiwilliger bittet um die Telefonnummer eines anderen Freiwilligen für eine Fahrgemeinschaft. Darfst du sie herausgeben?

P1.q: By when must weekly hours be logged?
P1.sl: Bis wann müssen die Wochenstunden eingetragen sein?

P1.q: It is the second Monday of the month. Do you send Priya the list of volunteers who missed two or more shifts?
P1.sl: Es ist der zweite Montag im Monat. Schickst du Priya die Liste der Freiwilligen, die zwei oder mehr Schichten verpasst haben?

P2.sl: 美術館はいつからいつまで休館しますか？

P2.q: What will be replaced in the renovation?
P2.sl: 改修で何を入れ替えますか？

P2.q: How much does the work cost and what share does the national government pay?
P2.sl: 工事費はいくらで、国はどのくらい負担しますか？

P2.q: How many exhibition rooms will be added?
P2.sl: 展示室は何室増えますか？

P2.q: During the closure, how many works are shown and where?
P2.sl: 休館中、何点の作品がどこで公開されますか？
P2.gold: About 300, at the city cultural centre (touring exhibition)

P2.q: At the touring exhibition, what do an adult and a 16-year-old high-school student pay?
P2.sl: 巡回展で、大人と16歳の高校生はいくら払いますか？

P2.q: When was the last major renovation and how did it go?
P2.sl: 前回の大規模改修はいつで、どうでしたか？

P2.q: What will be done this time to keep to the schedule?
P2.sl: 今回、工期を守るために何をしますか？

P2.q: When does it reopen and what happens that day?
P2.sl: 再開はいつで、その日に何がありますか？
P2.gold: Aug 1; first 1000 visitors get a commemorative catalogue

P3.q: When and where is the lunch?
P3.gold: Saturday March 14, 14:00, El Olivo in Toledo

P3.q: How many people are going and how much is the menu per person?
P3.sl: ¿Cuántas personas van y cuánto cuesta el menú por persona?

P3.q: How much does the menu cost for a 7-year-old?
P3.sl: ¿Cuánto cuesta el menú para un niño de 7 años?

P3.q: How much does the menu cost for a 12-year-old?
P3.sl: ¿Cuánto cuesta el menú para un niño de 12 años?

P3.q: Who drives the aunts and uncles, from where, and at what time?
P3.sl: ¿Quién lleva a los tíos, desde dónde y a qué hora?
P3.gold: Andrés, from Atocha station in Madrid, 11:30

P3.q: What is the gift and who is it for?
P3.sl: ¿Cuál es el regalo y para quién es?
P3.gold: Trip to Lisbon for grandma and aunt Carmen

P3.q: How much does each adult contribute, to whom, and by when?
P3.sl: ¿Cuánto pone cada adulto, a quién y para cuándo?
P3.gold: €40, by Bizum to Lucía, before March 5

P3.q: May you mention the party to grandma?
P3.sl: ¿Puedes mencionarle la fiesta a la abuela?

P3.q: Why was a ground-floor table requested, and who requested it?
P3.sl: ¿Por qué se pidió una mesa en la planta baja y quién la pidió?
P3.gold: Andrés; no lift and the room is on the first floor

P3.q: What cake will there be, what must it not contain, and why?
P3.sl: ¿Qué tarta habrá, qué no debe llevar y por qué?
P3.gold: Chocolate, no nuts, Pablo is allergic

P3.q: Until what time is the room reserved?
P3.sl: ¿Hasta qué hora está reservado el salón?

P4.q: Who makes the announcement, what changes, and from when?
P4.sl: Chi fa l'annuncio, cosa cambia e da quando?
P4.gold: The municipality (Comune) of San Lorenzo al Mare; door-to-door sorted collection; from April 1

P4.q: Who is quoted and what is his role?
P4.sl: Chi viene citato e che ruolo ha?

P4.q: How much will the new service cost and how does that compare with the current contract?
P4.sl: Quanto costerà il nuovo servizio e come si confronta con il contratto attuale?

P4.q: On which days is organic waste collected?
P4.sl: In quali giorni viene ritirato l'umido?

P4.q: Is glass collected door to door?
P4.sl: Il vetro viene ritirato porta a porta?
P4.gold: No, it stays in the street bins

P4.q: May you put your bags out at 7 p.m. the evening before?
P4.sl: Puoi esporre i sacchetti alle 19 della sera prima?

P4.q: May you put your bags out at 7 a.m. on collection day?
P4.sl: Puoi esporre i sacchetti alle 7 del mattino del giorno di raccolta?

P4.q: A family with a 2-year-old: what extra service can they request?
P4.sl: Una famiglia con un bambino di 2 anni: quale servizio extra può chiedere?

P4.q: Can a family whose youngest child is 4 request that service?
P4.sl: Una famiglia il cui figlio più piccolo ha 4 anni può chiedere quel servizio?

P4.q: The first time someone puts their waste out incorrectly, do they get a fine?
P4.sl: La prima volta che qualcuno espone male i rifiuti, riceve una multa?
P4.gold: No, first a warning (then a €50 fine)

P4.q: Where and when can you get the new bins, and what must you bring?
P4.sl: Dove e quando si ritirano i nuovi bidoni e cosa bisogna portare?
P4.gold: Town hall, March 10-28, free; bring the TARI bill

P5.q: When does this procedure run and which mailbox do you check?
P5.sl: Wanneer loopt deze procedure en welke mailbox controleer je?

P5.q: A customer returns an item 20 days after delivery. May you send a return label yourself?
P5.sl: Een klant stuurt iets terug 20 dagen na levering. Mag je zelf een retourlabel sturen?

P5.q: A customer wants to return an item 45 days after delivery. What do you do?
P5.sl: Een klant wil iets terugsturen 45 dagen na levering. Wat doe je?
P5.gold: No label; put the request to Ms De Vries

P5.q: A customer asks for a refund. May you refund them, and who does?
P5.sl: Een klant vraagt om terugbetaling. Mag jij terugbetalen, en wie doet het?
P5.gold: No; only Mr Bakker from accounting

P5.q: A customer reports that a handlebar snapped dangerously. What do you do, and may you admit fault?
P5.sl: Een klant meldt dat een stuur gevaarlijk is afgebroken. Wat doe je, en mag je schuld erkennen?
P5.gold: Ask for photos, warn Ms De Vries immediately, do not admit fault

P5.q: A delivery was late. May you offer an 8% discount code?
P5.sl: Een levering was te laat. Mag je een kortingscode van 8% geven?

P5.q: A delivery was late. May you offer a 15% discount code?
P5.sl: Een levering was te laat. Mag je een kortingscode van 15% geven?

P5.q: A customer sending back a product asks for a discount code. May you give one?
P5.sl: Een klant die een product terugstuurt vraagt om een kortingscode. Mag je die geven?

P5.q: Who is the owner, and may you cc him on customer emails?
P5.sl: Wie is de eigenaar, en mag je hem in cc zetten bij klantmails?

P5.q: How should you refer to Ms De Vries?
P5.sl: Hoe moet je mevrouw De Vries noemen?
P5.gold: As the customer service manager, not the owner

P5.q: What must you send before 4 p.m., and to whom?
P5.sl: Wat moet je vóór 16:00 sturen, en aan wie?
P5.gold: Overview of the day's returns to Ms De Vries
